content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The post-wise selection process will be conducted according to the University of Delhi recruitment rules. Depending on the post, it may include: Written examination Skill or typing test, where applicable Document verification

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Maitreyi College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the University of Delhi Non-Teaching Recruitment Portal at dunt.uod.ac.in . Complete the new-candidate registration process. Select Maitreyi College and the post for which you want to apply. Enter the required personal, educational, experience and category details. Upload the photograph, signature and required certificates. Pay the applicable application fee through the available payment method. Review the entered information carefully. Submit the online application and save a copy for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications will be accepted only through the prescribed online portal. Candidates must satisfy the post-wise educational qualification, age and experience requirements. Applicants seeking reservation must upload a valid category or disability certificate. Candidates applying for more than one post should follow the separate-application instructions on the portal. Any addendum or corrigendum will be published only on the Maitreyi College website. Applicants should regularly monitor the college and recruitment websites for updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: Maitreyi College has announced 52 permanent non-teaching vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are included in the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Administrative Officer, Senior Assistant, Junior Assistant, Library Attendant, Laboratory Assistant and Laboratory Attendant posts.

faq.question: Q3. How many Laboratory Attendant vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 24 Laboratory Attendant vacancies across the Botany, Chemistry, Physics and Zoology departments.

faq.question: Q4. How many Laboratory Assistant vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are nine Laboratory Assistant vacancies across four science departments.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The notice specifies 9 October 2026 or two weeks from the advertisement's publication date, whichever is later. Applicants should follow the final deadline shown on the online portal.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the University of Delhi Non-Teaching Recruitment Portal.
